title.zh: 卷二十五 本紀第二十五: 仁宗二
title.raw: 卷二十五 本紀第二十五: 仁宗二 Volume 25 Annals 25: Renzong 2

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，立印經提舉司。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengshen day the Scripture Printing Intendant Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on gengshen day the Scripture Printing Intendant Office was established.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，大寧路地震。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Daning Route suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Daning Route suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，熒惑犯東井。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Mars transgressed Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Mars transgressed Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以侍御史趙世延為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day attendant censor Zhao Shiyan was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day attendant censor Zhao Shiyan was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 詔免蒙古地差稅二年，商賈勿免。

translations.literal: An edict exempted land tax in Mongol territory for two years; merchants were not exempted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict exempted land tax in Mongol territory for two years; merchants were not exempted.

sentences.zh: 己卯，給鈔六千三百錠，賑濟良鄉諸驛。

translations.literal: On jimao day six thousand three hundred ingots of notes were issued to relieve the relay stations of Liangxiang and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day 6,300 ingots of notes were issued to relieve the relay stations of Liangxiang and others.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以合散為中書右丞相、監修國史。

translations.literal: On renwu day Hesan was made right chancellor of the central secretariat and compiler of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Hesan was made right chancellor of the central secretariat and compiler of the national history.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以中書參政高昉為集賢學士。

translations.literal: On guiwei day central secretariat associate administrator Gao Fang was made Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day central secretariat associate administrator Gao Fang was made Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，太陰掩熒惑。

translations.literal: Third month, on renchen day the moon obscured Mars.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on renchen day the moon obscured Mars.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王塔失蒙古鈔千錠、衣二襲。

translations.literal: Prince Tashih was granted one thousand ingots of Mongol notes and two suits of clothing.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Tashih was granted 1,000 ingots of Mongol notes and two suits of clothing.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，真定、保定、河間民饑，給糧兩月。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the people of Zhending, Baoding, and Hejian suffered famine; grain for two months was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the people of Zhending, Baoding, and Hejian suffered famine; grain for two months was issued.

sentences.zh: 己亥，白暈亙天，連環貫日。

translations.literal: On jihai day a white halo spanned heaven, linked rings piercing the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day a white halo spanned heaven, linked rings piercing the sun.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，暹國王遣其臣愛耽入貢。

translations.literal: On guimao day the king of Siam dispatched his minister Aitan to enter tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the king of Siam dispatched his minister Aitan to enter tribute.

sentences.zh: 改南劍路曰延平，劍浦縣曰南平。

translations.literal: Nanjian Route was renamed Yanping; Jianpu County was renamed Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjian Route was renamed Yanping; Jianpu County was renamed Nanping.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以僧人作佛事，擇釋獄囚，命中書審察。

translations.literal: On yisi day, because monks performed Buddhist rites to select prisoners for release, the central secretariat was ordered to examine the matter.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, because monks performed Buddhist rites to select prisoners for release, the central secretariat was ordered to examine the matter.

sentences.zh: 丙午，封阿魯禿為趙王。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Arghun was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Arghun was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 戊申，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On wushen day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 己酉，敕：「奸民宮其子為閹宦，謀避徭役者，罪之。

translations.literal: On jiyou day an edict: "Wicked commoners who castrate their sons as palace eunuchs to evade corvée shall be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict directed, "Wicked commoners who castrate their sons as palace eunuchs to evade corvée shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，命參知政事趙世延綱領國子學。

translations.literal: " On xinhai day associate administrator Zhao Shiyan was ordered to take overall charge of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinhai day associate administrator Zhao Shiyan was ordered to take overall charge of the National University.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，中書平章政事察罕致仕。

translations.literal: On guichou day central secretariat grand councillor Chaghan retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day central secretariat grand councillor Chaghan retired from office.

sentences.zh: 晉寧民侯喜兒昆弟五人，並坐法當死，帝嘆曰：「彼一家不幸而有是事，其擇情輕者一人杖之，俾養父母，毋絕其祀。」

translations.literal: The people of Jinning, Hou Xier and his five brothers, were all by law liable to death; the Emperor sighed and said: "That household was unfortunate to have this matter; let one of lighter culpability be chosen and beaten with the rod, so he may support his parents and their sacrificial line not be cut off."
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jinning, Hou Xier and his five brothers, were all by law liable to death; the Emperor sighed and said, "That household was unfortunate to have this matter; let one of lighter culpability be chosen and beaten with the rod, so he may support his parents and their sacrificial line not be cut off."

sentences.zh: 閏三月甲寅朔，敕減樞密知院冗員。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, on jiayin new moon an edict reduced redundant posts among privy council vice directors.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary third month, on jiayin new moon an edict reduced redundant posts among privy council vice directors.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太陰犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the moon transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the moon transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 罷咒僧月給俸。

translations.literal: Monthly stipends to incantation monks were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly stipends to incantation monks were abolished.

sentences.zh: 遣人視大都至上都駐蹕之地，有侵民田者，計畝給直。

translations.literal: Men were dispatched to inspect the halting encampment grounds from Dadu to the Upper Capital; where civilian fields had been encroached upon, compensation per mu was calculated and paid.
translations.idiomatic: Men were dispatched to inspect the halting encampment grounds from Dadu to the Upper Capital; where civilian fields had been encroached upon, compensation per mu was calculated and paid.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太陰犯太微東垣。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，畿內及諸衛屯軍饑，賑鈔七千五百錠。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the capital region and garrison-farm troops of the various guards suffered famine; seven thousand five hundred ingots of notes were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the capital region and garrison-farm troops of the various guards suffered famine; 7,500 ingots of notes were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 汴梁、濟寧、東昌等路，隴州、開州，青城、齊東、渭源、東明、長垣等縣，隕霜殺桑果禾苗，歸州告饑，出糧減價賑糶。

translations.literal: Bianliang, Jining, Dongchang and other routes; Long Prefecture and Kai Prefecture; Qingcheng, Qidong, Weiyuan, Dongming, Changyuan and other counties — frost killed mulberry trees, fruit trees, and seedlings; Guizhou reported famine; grain was issued and sold at reduced price for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Bianliang, Jining, Dongchang and other routes; Long Prefecture and Kai Prefecture; Qingcheng, Qidong, Weiyuan, Dongming, Changyuan and other counties — frost killed mulberry trees, fruit trees, and seedlings; Guizhou reported famine; grain was issued and sold at reduced price for relief.

sentences.zh: 馬八兒國主昔剌木丁遣其臣愛思丁貢方物。

translations.literal: The king of Ma'bar, Siramaldin, dispatched his minister Aisiding to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Ma'bar, Siramaldin, dispatched his minister Aisiding to present local products.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅朔，賜營王也先鐵木兒鈔萬錠。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiayin new moon Prince of Ying Yesian Temür was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jiayin new moon Prince of Ying Yesian Temür was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 戊午，辰星犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Mercury transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Mercury transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賜李孟孝感縣地二十八頃。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Li Meng was granted twenty-eight qing of land in Xiaogan County.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Li Meng was granted 28 qing of land in Xiaogan County.

sentences.zh: 禁諸王支屬徑取分地租賦擾民。

translations.literal: Princes' collateral branches were forbidden to directly seize apportioned-fief rent and levies to harass the people.
translations.idiomatic: Princes' collateral branches were forbidden to directly seize apportioned-fief rent and levies to harass the people.

sentences.zh: 敕嶺北行省瘞陣沒遺骼。

translations.literal: An edict directed the Lingbei branch secretariat to bury battlefield remains.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed the Lingbei branch secretariat to bury battlefield remains.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賑怯魯連地貧乏者米三千石。

translations.literal: On yihai day three thousand shi of grain were issued to relieve the destitute of Qielolian.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day 3,000 shi of grain were issued to relieve the destitute of Qielolian.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，徙滄州治於長蘆鎮。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Cangzhou's seat of government was moved to Changlu Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Cangzhou's seat of government was moved to Changlu Fort.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，京兆為故儒臣許衡立魯齋書院，降璽書旌之。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, for the former Confucian minister Xu Heng, the Lu Studio Academy was established at Jingzhao; an imperial letter was sent down to honor him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, for the former Confucian minister Xu Heng, the Lu Studio Academy was established at Jingzhao; an imperial letter was sent down to honor him.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，盧陽、麻陽二縣以土賊作耗，蠲其地稅賦。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Luyang and Mayang counties, because of bandit raids, had their land taxes and levies remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Luyang and Mayang counties, because of bandit raids, had their land taxes and levies remitted.

sentences.zh: 營王也先鐵木兒支屬貧乏，賑糧兩月。

translations.literal: The impoverished collateral following of Prince of Ying Yesian Temür was relieved with grain for two months.
translations.idiomatic: The impoverished collateral following of Prince of Ying Yesian Temür was relieved with grain for two months.

sentences.zh: 武陵縣霖雨，水溢，溺死居民，漂沒廬舍禾稼，潭州、漢陽、思州民饑，並發廩減價糶賑之。

translations.literal: Wuling County suffered heavy rain and water overflow; residents drowned, and dwellings and crops were washed away; the people of Tanzhou, Hanyang, and Sizhou suffered famine — in all cases granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Wuling County suffered heavy rain and water overflow; residents drowned, and dwellings and crops were washed away; the people of Tanzhou, Hanyang, and Sizhou suffered famine — in all cases granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.

sentences.zh: 膚施縣大風、雹，損禾並傷人畜。

translations.literal: Fushi County suffered wind and hail, damaging crops and injuring people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Fushi County suffered wind and hail, damaging crops and injuring people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，敕：「內侍今後止授中官，勿畀文階。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wuzi day an edict: "Henceforth inner attendants shall be granted only eunuch posts and not civil ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on wuzi day an edict directed, "Henceforth inner attendants shall be granted only eunuch posts and not civil ranks.

sentences.zh: 」置雲南行省儒學提舉司。

translations.literal: " The Yunnan Branch Secretariat Confucianism Intendant Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: " The Yunnan Branch Secretariat Confucianism Intendant Office was established.

sentences.zh: 封河南省丞相卜憐吉帶為河南王。

translations.literal: Henan Province chancellor Bolinjidai was enfeoffed as Prince of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Province chancellor Bolinjidai was enfeoffed as Prince of Henan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，增置畿內州縣同知、主簿各一員。

translations.literal: On renchen day one additional subprefect and registrar each were added for inner-circuit prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day one additional subprefect and registrar each were added for inner-circuit prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 諸王察八兒屬戶匱乏，給糧一歲，仍俾屯田以自贍。

translations.literal: Prince Chaba'er's dependent households were destitute; grain for one year was issued, and they were still ordered to garrison-farm for self-support.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chaba'er's dependent households were destitute; grain for one year was issued, and they were still ordered to garrison-farm for self-support.

sentences.zh: 發軍增墾河南芍陂等處屯田。

translations.literal: Troops were dispatched to expand garrison farming at Henan Shao Marsh and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were dispatched to expand garrison farming at Henan Shao Marsh and other places.

sentences.zh: 乙未，熒惑犯右執法。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Mars transgressed Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Mars transgressed Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 戊申，增置兩浙鹽運司判官一員。

translations.literal: On wushen day one additional vice director was added to the Liang-Zhe Salt Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day one additional vice director was added to the Liang-Zhe Salt Transport Commission.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，拘河西僧免輸租賦璽書。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the imperial letters exempting Hexi monks from rent and levies were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the imperial letters exempting Hexi monks from rent and levies were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 敕：「諸王、戚裏入覲者，趁夏時芻牧至上都，毋輒入京師，有事則遣使奏稟。

translations.literal: An edict: "Princes and imperial affines coming to court shall graze their herds to the Upper Capital in summer and not rashly enter the capital; if there is business, they shall dispatch envoys to memorialize and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed, "Princes and imperial affines coming to court shall graze their herds to the Upper Capital in summer and not rashly enter the capital; if there is business, they shall dispatch envoys to memorialize and report.

sentences.zh: 」衡州、郴州、興國、永州路、耒陽州饑，發廩減價賑糶。

translations.literal: " Hengzhou, Chenzhou, Xingguo, Yongzhou Route, and Leiyang Prefecture suffered famine; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.
translations.idiomatic: " Hengzhou, Chenzhou, Xingguo, Yongzhou Route, and Leiyang Prefecture suffered famine; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.

sentences.zh: 宣平、仁壽、白登縣雹損稼，傷人畜。

translations.literal: Xuanping, Renshou, and Baideng counties suffered hail damage to crops, injuring people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanping, Renshou, and Baideng counties suffered hail damage to crops, injuring people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，答即乃所部匱乏，戶給糧二石。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, on yimao day Dajinai's following was destitute; two shi of grain per household were issued.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, autumn, on yimao day Dajinai's following was destitute; two shi of grain per household were issued.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命中書省臣議復封贈，賜晉王也孫鐵木兒部鈔十萬錠。

translations.literal: On gengwu day the central secretariat was ordered to deliberate on restoring posthumous enfeoffment; Prince of Jin Yesun Temür's following was granted one hundred thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the central secretariat was ordered to deliberate on restoring posthumous enfeoffment; Prince of Jin Yesun Temür's following was granted 100,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 詔開下番市舶之禁。

translations.literal: An edict opened the prohibition on off-season maritime trade.
translations.idiomatic: An edict opened the prohibition on off-season maritime trade.

sentences.zh: 賜衛王阿木哥等鈔七千錠。

translations.literal: Prince Wei Amuge and others were granted seven thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Wei Amuge and others were granted 7,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，會福院越制奏旨除官，敕自今舉人，聽中書可否以聞。

translations.literal: On yihai day Huifu Court exceeded its authority in memorializing imperial decisions to appoint officials; an edict directed that from now on all nominees be submitted to the central secretariat for approval and report.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Huifu Court exceeded its authority in memorializing imperial decisions to appoint officials; an edict directed that from now on all nominees be submitted to the central secretariat for approval and report.

sentences.zh: 申飭私鹽之禁。

translations.literal: Private salt prohibitions were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Private salt prohibitions were strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 沅陵、盧溪二縣水，武清縣渾河堤決，淹沒民田，發廩賑之。

translations.literal: Yuanling and Luxi counties suffered flooding; the Hun River dike burst at Wuqing County, inundating civilian fields; granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanling and Luxi counties suffered flooding; the Hun River dike burst at Wuqing County, inundating civilian fields; granaries were opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，車駕至大都。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on wuzi day the imperial carriage reached Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on wuzi day the imperial carriage reached Dadu.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，升太常寺為太常禮儀院，秩正二品。

translations.literal: On guimao day the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was raised to the Grand Ceremony Court, rank 2a.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was raised to the Grand Ceremony Court, rank 2a.

sentences.zh: 丁未，冀寧、汴梁及武安、涉縣地震，壞官民廬舍，武安死者十四人，涉縣三百二十六人。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Jining, Bianliang, and Wu'an and She counties suffered earthquakes, destroying official and civilian dwellings; at Wu'an fourteen persons died, at She County three hundred twenty-six persons.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Jining, Bianliang, and Wu'an and She counties suffered earthquakes, destroying official and civilian dwellings; at Wu'an 14 persons died, at She County 326 persons.

sentences.zh: 臺州、岳州、武岡、常德、道州等路水，發廩減價賑糶。

translations.literal: Taizhou, Yuezhou, Wugang, Changde, Daozhou and other routes suffered flooding; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Taizhou, Yuezhou, Wugang, Changde, Daozhou and other routes suffered flooding; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，改提點教坊司事為大使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renxu day the intendant of the Teaching Workshop was changed to envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on renxu day the intendant of the Teaching Workshop was changed to envoy.

sentences.zh: 己巳，復以鐵木叠兒為右丞相，合散為左丞相。

translations.literal: On jisi day Temüder was again made right chancellor; Hesan was made left chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Temüder was again made right chancellor; Hesan was made left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 罷陜西諸道行御史臺，降儀鳳卿為儀鳳大使。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Branch Censorate was abolished; the Ceremonial Phoenix Commissioner was reduced to Ceremonial Phoenix envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Branch Censorate was abolished; the Ceremonial Phoenix Commissioner was reduced to Ceremonial Phoenix envoy.

sentences.zh: 肇慶、武昌、建德、建康、南康、江州、袁州、建昌、贛州、杭州、撫州、安豐等路水，發廩減價賑糶。

translations.literal: Zhaoqing, Wuchang, Jiande, Jiankang, Nankang, Jiangzhou, Yuanzhou, Jianchang, Ganzhou, Hangzhou, Fuzhou, Anfeng and other routes suffered flooding; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoqing, Wuchang, Jiande, Jiankang, Nankang, Jiangzhou, Yuanzhou, Jianchang, Ganzhou, Hangzhou, Fuzhou, Anfeng and other routes suffered flooding; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，升潁州萬戶府為中萬戶府。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, on guisi day Yingzhou Wanhu Office was raised to Central Wanhu Office.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, winter, on guisi day Yingzhou Wanhu Office was raised to Central Wanhu Office.

sentences.zh: 乙未，敕：「吏人轉官，止從七品，在選者降等註授。

translations.literal: On yiwei day an edict: "When clerks and functionaries transfer to office, they shall stop at seventh rank; those awaiting selection shall be registered at reduced grade.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict directed, "When clerks and functionaries transfer to office, they shall stop at seventh rank; those awaiting selection shall be registered at reduced grade.

sentences.zh: 」申飭內侍及諸司隔越中書奏請之禁。

translations.literal: " Prohibitions against inner attendants and other offices bypassing the central secretariat in memorializing and requesting were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: " Prohibitions against inner attendants and other offices bypassing the central secretariat in memorializing and requesting were strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 敕：「下番商販須江浙省給牒以往，歸則征稅如制，私往者沒其物。

translations.literal: An edict: "Off-season merchant traders must obtain passes from the Jiang-Zhe province before departing; on return taxes shall be levied according to regulation; those who go privately shall have their goods confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed, "Off-season merchant traders must obtain passes from the Jiang-Zhe province before departing; on return taxes shall be levied according to regulation; those who go privately shall have their goods confiscated.

sentences.zh: 」遣官括淮民所佃閑田不輸稅者。

translations.literal: " Officials were dispatched to register idle fields farmed by Huai region commoners on which no tax was paid.
translations.idiomatic: " Officials were dispatched to register idle fields farmed by Huai region commoners on which no tax was paid.

sentences.zh: 丙申，復甘肅屯田，置沙瓜等處屯儲總管萬戶府，秩正三品。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Gansu garrison farming was restored; the Shagu and other places garrison-store overall wanhu office was established, rank 3a.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Gansu garrison farming was restored; the Shagu and other places garrison-store overall wanhu office was established, rank 3a.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，置恩平王塔思不花傅二人。

translations.literal: On yisi day two tutors were established for Prince of Enping Tasibuhua.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day two tutors were established for Prince of Enping Tasibuhua.

translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

translations.idiomatic: Hunting throughout the realm during spring was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太白經天。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Venus transited the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Venus transited the heavens.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，以江南行臺侍御史高昉為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinwei day Jiangnan branch censorate attendant censor Gao Fang was made central secretariat associate administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on xinwei day Jiangnan branch censorate attendant censor Gao Fang was made central secretariat associate administrator.

sentences.zh: 壬申，有事於太廟。

translations.literal: On renshen day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 調四川軍二千人、雲南軍三千人烏蒙等處屯田，置總管萬戶府，秩正三品，設官四員，隸雲南省。

translations.literal: Two thousand Sichuan troops and three thousand Yunnan troops were mobilized to garrison-farm at Wumeng and other places; an overall commander-of-ten-thousand office was established at third rank, with four officials, subordinate to Yunnan Province.
translations.idiomatic: 2,000 Sichuan troops and 3,000 Yunnan troops were mobilized to garrison-farm at Wumeng and other places; an overall commander-of-ten-thousand office was established at third rank, with four officials, subordinate to Yunnan Province.

sentences.zh: 壬午，河南路地震。

translations.literal: On renwu day Henan Route suffered earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Henan Route suffered earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太白犯鬥。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Venus transgressed Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Venus transgressed Dipper.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，敕五臺靈鷲寺置鐵冶提舉司。

translations.literal: On gengyin day an edict directed that an Iron Smelting Intendant Office be established at Wutai Lingjiu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict directed that an iron smelting intendant office be established at Wutai Lingjiu Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賜豳王南忽裏部鈔四萬錠。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Prince Bin Nanhuli's division was granted forty thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Prince Bin Nanhuli's division was granted 40,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，修甘州城。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Ganzhou city was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Ganzhou city was repaired.

sentences.zh: 申禁民有父在者，不得私貸人錢及鬻墓木。

translations.literal: An edict was announced forbidding commoners whose father is alive from privately lending money to others or selling tomb timber.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was announced forbidding commoners whose father is alive from privately lending money to others or selling tomb timber.

sentences.zh: 甘州、肅州等路饑，免田租。

translations.literal: Ganzhou, Suzhou, and other routes suffered famine; land rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Ganzhou, Suzhou, and other routes suffered famine; land rent was remitted.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，命監察御史監治嶺北鉤校錢糧，半歲更代。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renyin day, supervising censors were ordered to supervise the Lingbei audit of revenues and grain, with rotation every half year.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on renyin day, supervising censors were ordered to supervise the Lingbei audit of revenues and grain, with rotation every half year.

sentences.zh: 大萬寧寺住持僧米普雲濟以所佩國公印移文有司，紊亂官政，敕禁止之。

translations.literal: Mipu Yunji, abbot of Dawanning Temple, used the state duke seal he wore to issue documents to the regular authorities, disrupting official government; an edict forbade this.
translations.idiomatic: Mipu Yunji, abbot of Dawanning Temple, used the state duke seal he wore to issue documents to the regular authorities, disrupting official government; an edict forbade this.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，增集寧、砂井、凈州路同知、府判、提控、案牘各一員。

translations.literal: On yisi day one post each of associate administrator, prefectural judge, supervisory controller, and clerical registrar was added at Jining, Shajing, and Jing routes.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day one post each of associate administrator, prefectural judge, supervisory controller, and clerical registrar was added at Jining, Shajing, and Jing routes.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，改舊運糧提舉司為大都陸運提舉司，新運糧提舉司為京畿運糧提舉司，澧州路安撫司為安定軍民府。

translations.literal: On yimao day the Former Grain Transport Intendant Office was renamed the Dadu Land Transport Intendant Office; the New Grain Transport Intendant Office was renamed the Capital Region Grain Transport Intendant Office; and the Lizhou Route Pacification Commission was renamed the Anding Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the former grain transport intendant office was renamed the Dadu land transport intendant office; the new grain transport intendant office was renamed the capital region grain transport intendant office; and the Lizhou Route pacification commission was renamed the Anding Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，以知樞密院事禿忽魯為陜西行省左丞相。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on gengwu day, Tuhulu, privy council director, was made left grand councillor of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on gengwu day, Tuhulu, privy council director, was made left grand councillor of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬午，授嗣漢三十九代天師張嗣成太玄輔化體仁應道大真人，主領三山符箓，掌江南道教事。

translations.literal: On renwu day Zhang Sicheng, thirty-ninth-generation successor Han Celestial Master, was granted the title Great Perfect Man of Supreme Mystery, Assisting Transformation, Embodying Benevolence, and Responding to the Way and put in charge of the Three Mountains talismans, administering Jiangnan Daoist affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Zhang Sicheng, thirty-ninth-generation successor Han Celestial Master, was granted the title Great Perfect Man of Supreme Mystery, Assisting Transformation, Embodying Benevolence, and Responding to the Way and put in charge of the Three Mountains talismans, administering Jiangnan Daoist affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，立皇子碩德八剌為皇太子，兼中書令、樞密使，授以金寶，告天地宗廟。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Prince Shidebala was installed as crown prince, concurrently central secretariat chancellor and privy council commissioner; he received the gold seal and treasure, and announcement was made to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Prince Shidebala was installed as crown prince, concurrently central secretariat chancellor and privy council commissioner; he received the gold seal and treasure, and announcement was made to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 升同知樞密院事床兀兒知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Associate privy council director Chuangwu'er was promoted to privy council director.
translations.idiomatic: Associate privy council director Chuangwu'er was promoted to privy council director.

sentences.zh: 諸王按灰部乏食，給米三千一百八十六石濟之。

translations.literal: Prince Anhui's division lacked food; three thousand one hundred eighty-six shi of grain were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Anhui's division lacked food; 3,186 shi of grain were granted in relief.
